answer: Recursive ZK-STARK commitments encapsulate the zephyr of agent interactions into an unforgeable pearl of reputation, while sequential verifiable delay functions prevent parallelized spoofing. This architecture transmutes the shale of raw identifiers into verified anchors, enforcing a strict information-theoretic bound on identity forgery. By coupling transitions to staking collateral and slashing penalties, we achieve a Nash equilibrium where the negative utility of Sybil attacks renders malicious cloning computationally infeasible.
